Arthur Machen, Short Fiction.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/arthur-machen/short-fiction

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Arthur Machen, the annotator and the author, died 1947 (Wikidata Q540166, P570 = 1947-12-15).

First publication of the text used: between 1894 and 1922 (SE colophon: 'Short Fiction was compiled from short stories and novellas written and published between 1894 and 1922 by Arthur Machen.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in between 1894 and 1922, before 1931, so it is in the United States public domain.
- Country of origin: the facts do not name the country of first publication. The possible countries are the United Kingdom, Ireland, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India and South Africa. Each of these has a term of life + 70 years or less. The United States is also possible, and the text was first published before 1931, so the United States rule settles that case (see above). The last person named above, Arthur Machen, died in 1947, so the text entered the public domain in each of the other possible countries on 1 January 2018.
